effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By adding the top or bottom card of your security stack to the hand, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn. Then, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from your hand at the bottom of your security stack.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait, gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
